requirements.text: Acknowledge receipt of every Addendum in writing and confirm in the Form of Tender that the tender price includes the effect of all Addenda issued.
Keep the tender valid and open for acceptance for 120 calendar days from the submission deadline.
Furnish a Tender Security (bid bond) of 2% of the tender price, issued by a bank licensed by the National Bank of Cambodia, denominated in US Dollars.
Ensure the Tender Security remains valid for 28 days beyond the expiry of the tender validity period.
Submit a valid Certificate of Incorporation, Patent Tax Certificate and VAT registration certificate.
Demonstrate average annual construction turnover of at least USD 8,000,000 over the last three financial years, supported by audited financial statements.
Demonstrate completion as main contractor of at least two similar projects in the last seven years, each not less than USD 4,000,000, with employer-signed completion certificates.
Demonstrate liquid assets or credit facilities of at least USD 1,500,000 with a bank reference letter issued within the last 90 days.
Nominate a Project Manager with a Civil or Structural Engineering degree and at least ten years of industrial construction experience, including three years as PM on pre-engineered steel buildings.
Nominate a Site Safety Officer holding a current recognised occupational health and safety qualification, present on site at all times during working hours.
Price every item in the Bill of Quantities; unpriced items are deemed included in other rates with no additional payment.
Quote rates in US Dollars as fixed for the duration of the Contract, with no adjustment for fluctuation in labour, materials or plant.
Submit one original plus three hard copies and one complete electronic copy on USB in searchable PDF format.
Submit the Technical Proposal and the Price Proposal in separate sealed envelopes, each marked with the Tender Reference.
Sign and stamp every page of the Form of Tender, Appendix to Tender and priced Bill of Quantities, and submit a Power of Attorney evidencing signing authority.
Submit any request for clarification in writing to the Consultant not later than 14 days before the submission deadline.
Within 28 days of the Letter of Acceptance, effect Contractor's All Risks insurance in joint names for the Accepted Contract Amount plus 15%.
Effect and maintain Workmen's Compensation and Third Party Liability insurance with a limit of indemnity of at least USD 500,000 per occurrence.
Submit with the tender a preliminary construction programme in bar chart form demonstrating completion within the 420-day Time for Completion.
